rationale: Ground truth has no substantive concerns (bot noise + 'thanks'), so both reviews are essentially graded on grounded thoroughness rather than recall. X is a competent, accurate pass/fail table with one well-reasoned edge-case comment (sm_110/cc 11.x) but stays mostly at a summary level. Y does deeper investigation (repo-wide greps for stale symbol/env references, caller chains, import-safety checks) and surfaces several concrete, file:line-anchored doc/metadata inconsistencies (fp8.md hardware table, section heading, pyproject.toml description) plus a defensible fail-closed suggestion mirroring an existing pattern in platform.py, all with explicit evidence trails — more actionable even if a couple of findings (e.g. requesting benchmark logs) are lower-value nitpicks.
